$comment: Robin Labs pad (root directory = pad/). The rewrite turns every <slug>.robinlabs.fun host into the coin-site serving page (site.html), which resolves the subdomain to a coin and renders its chosen template. robinlab.io (the pad's primary domain) is untouched because the rewrite only fires on the *.robinlabs.fun host condition. Add *.robinlabs.fun (wildcard) as a domain on THIS Vercel project for it to take effect.
